intent: Shifted sensors inward by 0.01 m to reduce lateral spacing and improve sensor coverage continuity through sharp turns on the slalom track, aiming to reduce line loss events and steering oscillation. Retained the sixth center-front sensor and sensor size for early detection benefits. Expect improved line detection and control stability on slalom, maintaining strong oval and s-bend performance.
rationale: Iteration 4's evidence shows that increasing sensor size to 0.016 m, adding a sixth sensor at the center front, and adjusting lateral sensor spacing outward improved line coverage and early detection on oval and s-bend tracks but slalom finish rates remain zero with high steering oscillation and line loss events. Integration feedback recommends reducing lateral spacing slightly to improve sensor coverage continuity through sharp turns and further reducing kp if oscillation remains high. Therefore, I have shifted all sensor x-positions inward by 0.01 m to reduce lateral spacing, keeping the sixth sensor at (0, 0.07) and sensor size at 0.016 m to maintain early detection benefits. Other geometry parameters remain unchanged to preserve stability. I expect this tighter sensor layout to improve line detection continuity on sharp turns, reduce line loss events and steering oscillation on the slalom track, and maintain strong performance on oval and s-bend tracks.
